description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY.md §3.6: specificadmintest, authorized only by its DSN-specific admin record, grants itself ego.dsn.read on the same DSN. DSNPermissionsHandler's route used to require identity ego.dsn.admin alone; it must now accept a per-DSN admin record checked per item (this request names only one DSN, but the fix is per-item to support a request naming several).
